detail.title: Intrinsic Motivation and Curiosity-Driven Problem Selection
detail.summary: An examination of how intrinsic reward signals such as prediction error and curiosity guide agents to explore environments and solve complex tasks without dense extrinsic rewards.
detail.reason: Sufficient collected sources are available for proj-autonomous-inquiry-1 to build a qualifying provisional notebook.
